description: React component implementing a file ingestion UI with upload areas, link to LinkedIn, and preview list for a Next.js frontend.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte size into a human-readable string.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension label or 'FILE' for files without extensions.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns the display title for each upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns the color accent associated with a category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the accepted file types string.
